remarks: A tranquil, private road leads to 2.42 acres of beautifully landscaped land. With Health Department approval for a five-bedroom septic system, this property offers the perfect opportunity to build your ideal home. No wetlands on the property. Enjoy the peace and privacy of your own oasis, all while being conveniently close to town, private schools, and the Merritt Parkway for easy access to NYC. Presently 2 income producing cottages- 22 Peepers Hollow and 33 Peepers Hollow.
